bio: With its street art-inspired decor and laid-back atmosphere, this restaurant couldn't be more hip. The quirky and creative self-taught chef fuses French culinary tradition with Indonesian influences. His wonderfully hot and spicy hot-and-cold rendang is a signature dish. But he just as deftly elevates sea bass fillet with grated Belper Knolle cheese and a rich jus seasoned with tom kha kai herbs. Jermain de Rozario is always on the hunt for unconventional flavours and is accompanied on his quest by an expert sommelier with a rock 'n' roll edge....
